sv.title: Tyskland nominerar till ECB-toppjobb
sv.summary: Tysklands regering föreslår att ekonomen Markus Brunnermeier blir ECB:s nya chefekonom. Det uppger finansminister Lars Klingbeils kansli för Reuters.

en.title: Germany nominates for ECB top job
en.summary: The German government proposes that economist Markus Brunnermeier become the ECB's new chief economist. This is according to the office of finance minister Lars Klingbeil, reports Reuters.
